How it works

A path forward.
One step at a time.

CraneQualified supports the development happening on your jobsite with structured learning and a record of what your people can demonstrate.

01 / Learn

Give experience a foundation.

A structured learning path helps employees understand the knowledge behind the work and identify what needs more attention.

  • Clear learning objectives for the role
  • Knowledge checks that reveal gaps
  • A shared starting point for field coaching

02 / Practice

Make the jobsite part of the plan.

Connect learning to supervised practice on relevant equipment and tasks. The employer sets appropriate assignments, supervision, and limits.

  • Practice objectives tied to the work
  • Observations and feedback from the trainer
  • Follow-up on the skills that need attention

03 / Verify

Turn progress into a clear record.

Bring learning, practice, and evaluation evidence together. Use documented competency to support the employer’s qualification and work authorization decisions.

  • Document what was demonstrated and observed
  • Identify remaining gaps and follow-up actions
  • Keep the employer’s decision and scope clear

A few things to know

Clear from
the start.

What is CraneQualified?

CraneQualified is an operator development and Verification of Competency program for crane and rigging employers. It supports structured learning, on-the-job practice, and competency documentation so employers can see development needs and plan next steps.

Does it replace on-the-job training?

No. It supports the work your trainers and supervisors already do. Learning objectives, supervised practice, and documented observations give that development a clearer structure.

Does course completion qualify an operator?

No. Course completion is one part of development. The employer remains responsible for determining qualification, meeting applicable certification or licensing and evaluation requirements, and authorizing work on the assigned equipment and tasks.

What happens after I send an inquiry?

Your details and request are saved in the business CRM for the CraneQualified team. The team can follow up to discuss your operation and agree on a next step. Submitting the form does not book a meeting or enroll you in a program. Marketing emails are a separate, optional choice.

Where do existing users sign in?

Use Portal Login in the navigation to open the existing CraneQualified portal. This website preview does not collect passwords or change portal access.
